training_level_range_chk.name: training_level_range_chk
training_level_range_chk.value: "training_level"."max_rating" IS NULL OR "training_level"."min_rating" IS NULL OR "training_level"."max_rating" > "training_level"."min_rating"

training_level_rating_kind_chk.name: training_level_rating_kind_chk
training_level_rating_kind_chk.value: "training_level"."kind" = 'LEVEL' OR ("training_level"."min_rating" IS NULL AND "training_level"."max_rating" IS NULL)

training_level_band_chk.name: training_level_band_chk
training_level_band_chk.value: "training_level"."kind" <> 'LEVEL' OR "training_level"."min_rating" IS NOT NULL OR "training_level"."max_rating" IS NOT NULL

training_session_range_chk.name: training_session_range_chk
training_session_range_chk.value: "training_session"."min_rating" IS NULL OR "training_session"."max_rating" IS NULL OR "training_session"."max_rating" >= "training_session"."min_rating"
